recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No further FHIR core source action is indicated; any remaining provider-group reporting example work should proceed in DEQM if still desired.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive R6 request to remove Group from MeasureReport.reporter after DEQM ReporterGroup had been incorporated into core, with a final resolution that Organization and PractitionerRole cover the core use cases and no additionalReporter extension is needed.
initial_application: Commit c6487923f555ea1723187bdb34ed052de50ae9d6 applied FHIR-38002 by deleting the Group targetProfile from source/measurereport/structuredefinition-MeasureReport.xml.

reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current source already contains the applied correction and source searches found no remaining core MeasureReport.reporter Group target.
